$comment: Enemy JSON schema - content/enemies/<id>/enemy.json (DESIGN.md sections 12 and 5; ticket T-013). No enemy data ships yet (enemy folders land with Wave 3, per FLEET_PACK merge order); the shape follows section 12 field names. anchor_kinds and stats are open vocabularies for now: anchor kinds come from TERRAIN_SPEC level anchors and enemy stats have no closed list in any document yet - tighten both when the wave landing the behaviors pins them.

arbiter.description: T-072 / SR-4: the declarative scheduling gate. Ids only - the vocabulary lives in sim/enemy_arbiter.gd.

behavior.$comment: one-line behavior summary, shown on the lobby altar panel (antechamber.gd); mirrors ENEMIES.md's behavior sentence

counter_play.$comment: one-line counter-play, shown on the lobby altar panel; from DESIGN.md section 5

contact_kill.$comment: D-T027-5 opt-out: false for the one enemy whose body contact never kills (thicc ben, T-032)

preferred_kind.$comment: spawn anchor kind; "none" skips (a) and (b) - the initial position is fallback (c) (DESIGN.md section 5; thicc ben, T-032)

script.$comment: true when the behavior needs an enemies/<id>/enemy.gd beyond defaults

sprites.$comment: resource path of this enemy's sprites.json (enemies/<id>/sprites.json), when frames exist

tell.$comment: the enemy's audio/visual tell, one line
